mapper.insert: insert into category( name, description, icon_bucket, icon_object_key ) values( #{name}, #{description}, #{iconBucket}, #{iconObjectKey} )
mapper.update: update category set name=#{name}, description=#{description}, icon_bucket=#{iconBucket}, icon_object_key=#{iconObjectKey}, update_time=#{updateTime} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, name, description, icon_bucket as iconBucket, icon_object_key as iconObjectKey, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from category order by id desc

select id, name, description, icon_bucket as iconBucket, icon_object_key as iconObjectKey, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from category
